dog.description_text:
What my friends at ACC say about me:

I would appreciate slow introductions to new people and places to help me feel safe.

I'm ready to learn! I need a patient person who has the time to work on training with me.

I love to be loved, but on my own terms! Let's brush up on some canine body language together!

I will need daily physical activity to keep me healthy and happy!

A Volunteer Wrote: "Don't you want to just squeeze his face and smother him in kisses?" a staff member asked as she saw me gazing at him in his pop-up crate. OMG-the woman is a mind reader! That FACE! All smushy and adorable! The body language-he's a dancer! A prancer! A master practitioner of joy! On a walk he is equally delightful, interested in absolutely everything around him, not reactive to other dogs, and occasionally tripping over himself as if he was just getting used to his paws. Cyrus is the most endearing goofball just waiting to be showered in love!
dog.name: Cyrus
